critical_code_review_comments: Session 126 diff is small, focused, and correct. LockedOverlay is now a pure presentational wrapper around PricingCards — good separation of concerns.
Auto-gen useEffect guard via `autoGenTriggeredRef.current` is the right pattern for React 18 StrictMode. Verified via live network monitoring: exactly 1 POST /generate-full per mount.

The useEffect dep array is [report, user] — this is fine because the ref+state guards short-circuit re-runs. Same effect will not re-fire when user object identity changes (which happens rarely in this app).
Silent-fail on auto-gen (console.warn only) is intentional per the code comment — the OPEN FULL SCOUT DOSSIER button remains available for manual retry. Good UX.

Minor code smell (non-blocking): the auto-gen path calls `pollFullReportReady()` (declared elsewhere in the file). Ensure that helper unmounts cleanly when the user navigates away mid-poll to avoid setState-after-unmount warnings. Not observed as an actual bug in this test run.

The two panel components (premium-access-panel + premium-generating-panel) share 80% of their JSX (background gradients, decorative blobs, Crown icon row). Consider extracting into `<PremiumTierCard state='ready'|'generating'/>` if further variations are added later.

ReportPage.jsx is now 3232 lines — should be split into feature-scoped subcomponents in a future refactor sweep (LockedOverlay, PremiumAccessPanel, PremiumGeneratingPanel, VideoMoments, etc. are all inlined here).
